title: Reuters investigation (11 Nov 2026): DoT ordered internet providers to block 129 betting websites in 2026 (34 on 21 Jul, purported Rajasthan HC order; 95 on 2 Sep, purported Allahabad HC order) on emailed documents presented as High Court orders that neither court's online records contain; Rajasthan HC registrar: 'appears to be fraudulent'; Allahabad HC judge's office: 'no such order has been passed'; Allahabad HC complaint and UP Police case on 6 Nov against unknown persons for alleged forgery and cheating; no arrests reported; DoT did not respond to Reuters; both directions still on DoT's website on 11 Nov (Reuters)
